title: Model catalog schema compatibility and pinning guidelines for open multilingual models
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Purpose: Establish a repeatable, backward-compatible schema and operational playbook for onboarding open multilingual models (eg. community LLMs and locally fine-tuned variants), pinning model versions for customer-facing routes, and publishing concise performance profiles used by Console and runtime routing. Goals: 1) Ensure catalog metadata fields support variant mapping, quantization labels, and kernel affinity without requiring runtime schema changes. 2) Define pinning semantics for model variants vs model versions so product teams can pick stable endpoints. 3) Produce a single-page performance profile template that includes p50/p95/p99 latency (cold and warm), GPU memory footprint, CPU fallbacks, token-throughput, quantized accuracy delta, and recommended batch profiles. Deliverables: - Catalog schema extension (new fields + deprecation plan) - Pinning guidelines doc for PMs/Platform engineers - Perf profile template and script to generate perf artifacts frombenchmarks - Console docs update and small SDK helper for pin-checking Acceptance criteria: - Schema changes are additive and pass compatibility linting on catalog CI - Two newly onboarded multilingual models have complete profiles and are pinned in staging routes - Console displays the perf summary card with correct metrics and links to benchmark artifacts - No change in runtime behavior without an explicit rollout flag (backward compatible), and canary rollout tested on dedicated pool

Notes & trade-offs: We prefer an additive-only schema to avoid breaking customers that consume catalog metadata directly. We will not attempt to reformat historical profiles now; instead we provide a migration translator for the Console. For pinning, we choose a two-level semantics: route_pin (what the user/application references) -> variant_pin (internal mapping to exact model binary). This gives operators the ability to swap variant_pin while keeping route_pin stable.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog schema updated and merged with add-only changes and migration notes
Benchmark runner produces perf profile JSON and artifact links stored in S3
Two multilingual models onboarded in staging with route_pin and variant_pin exercised
Console renders perf summary and links to raw artifacts
API/SDK helper for verifying pin compatibility released
implementation_notes: Add fields: supported_languages (list), variant_family, quantization_tags, kernel_affinity_hint, memory_estimate_mib, perf_artifact_url
Update catalog linter to fail on use of removed fields and warn on unknown fields
Benchmark runner: extend to collect cold start, warm p50/p95/p99, peak_gpu_memory_mb, avg_tokens_per_sec
Pin semantics: introduce route_pin -> variant_pin mapping and a pin-rollout flag (catalog.pin_rollout=true)
Runtime: no behavior change unless catalog.pin_rollout is true; default routes remain resolved by existing heuristics
Console: add perf summary card and 'pin history' timeline for each route
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha K: Drafted schema changes and pinned initial field list. Shared with infra and runtime teams for feedback.
2026-03-04 - Marco R: Reviewed; asked for a kernel_affinity_hint to help runtime choose kernel variants. Also requested p99 tail-latency to be split into cold/warm.
2026-03-05 - Linh Tran (runtime): Agreed to add kernel_affinity_hint but cautioned that hints are advisory only; runtime will ignore if unavailable.
2026-03-07 - PM review (Sofia Mendes): Asked for explicit rollout playbook steps and a rollback path if accuracy drops with a quantized variant.
2026-03-09 - QA (Jae Park): Added test checklist to validate perf artifacts in S3, Console rendering, and canary traffic split behavior.
2026-03-11 - Marco R: Opened PR to update catalog schema and linter (see github_pr). Requesting final review from infra and console owners.

2026-03-12 - Aisha K: Ran benchmarks for 'polyglot-lite-v2' and 'eastern-tower-3b' in staging; attached perf_artifact urls in PR comments. Initial results show 12% throughput drop for the int8 variant with <1% accuracy delta on eval set.
qa_checklist: Perf artifacts present in S3 with stable file names
Catalog CI linter passes for new schema additions
Canary route created and traffic split validated (10% -> variant_pin)
Console perf card loads without console errors
Rollback tested by toggling catalog.pin_rollout flag
rollback_plan: If quantized variant causes unacceptable quality regression, revert variant_pin to previous value and set catalog.pin_rollout=false. Notify affected teams and run a postmortem. For customer-facing routes, issue a temporary routing override to previous model binary until fix validated.
out_of_scope: Reformatting historical perf artifacts. Bulk re-pin of all existing routes. Major runtime kernel changes beyond advisory hints.
notes_for_doc_authors: Update 'Model Onboarding' Confluence page with the new field descriptions and add a short how-to for PMs: how to request a route_pin, how to interpret perf profile metrics, and how to schedule a canary. Include links to the benchmark runner repo and sample artifacts.
